title: Body Parts
label: ch:ta-body-parts
canDo: I can say head and hand in Tamil, account for why both stayed native here where Hindi's pair came from Sanskrit, and write நன்றி from its pieces.

payoff.summary: Complete TA-C13-checkpoint, the chapter's closing checkpoint: say talai and kai as native words, explain the d in nandri, describe க and where ◌ி attaches, find ர in சரி, then write க, ர, றி and நன்றி from sound.
payoff.note: TA-C13-checkpoint (sequence 575, TA-PATH-019 order 1, after TA-S117-letter-ra and before chapter 14's first lesson) assesses all six atoms the chapter introduces (6/6). It is the payoff because five of them, க (TA-S06-ka, 565), the i-sign, நன்றி and its ndr (TA-W04-i-sign-write-nandri, 570) and ர (TA-S117-letter-ra, 571), are taught after the spoken lesson TA-C13-udal-uruppugal (560), which could honestly assess only head and hand (1/6); that lesson stays as the chapter's spoken lesson. The script lessons sit on the earlier TA-PATH-003 and TA-PATH-100 segments, so the checkpoint comes after all of them on the sequence and on the path.
